Carrier note from PR #29930 (#29903, ACCEPT at `6a0150f1`): the base export now leaves out only the base's own `.custom` pair's extension. An extension contributed by an install-local non-pair package (and one on a writable base) still folds into the base's export on purpose, because that extender's own export omits `objectExtensions` (this card); excluding it first would drop the field from the bundle. Whoever fixes this card should also pass that extender to the per-package layer's `withoutExtensionsOf` (or generalise it to every non-owner extender) so the base export carries the base unchanged in that case too (ADR-0146 D8 item 3).
